edges.owner: StockLedgerShell navigation/content geometry + surface ScrollView/action layout
edges.evidence: Full Playwright run measured current primary actions below initial viewport at desktop1366x768 (Today y879), mobile360x800 (Today y868; Recipes action bottom866), mobile390x844 (Today y868; Alerts inspect bottom867), holdout412x915 (Today y1029), and Korean Alerts desktop1280x720 (action bottom805). Deep tests recorded nav y=-1321/-1514 while scanner save remained y697 and selected-stock action y503 while nav y=-612.
edges.finding: Critical next actions fall below the initial viewport in exercised compact/short profiles. The E2E geometry checks fail. The task remains scroll-reachable; impact is delayed access/poor first-task composition, not a claim of permanent inaccessibility.
edges.rootCause: Current shell uses absolute-positioned navigation plus compact content bottom padding; long content scrolls the navigation out of view and surface content places primary actions below initial short viewport.
